page_title: Plus AI presentation maker | Stop making slides the old way

sources.entry: Plusdocs - Tool for enhancing PowerPoint and Google Slides presentations.

summary.name: Plus AI (Plusdocs)
summary.one_liner: Plus is an AI assistant that runs as a native add-on inside PowerPoint and Google Slides to generate, rewrite, and reformat presentations.
use_cases: Generate a full slide deck from a text prompt
Convert a blog post, article, or document into slides
Reformat existing slides into new layouts
Keep team presentations on brand with custom templates
Create client proposals or company updates from saved presets
Translate or rewrite slide text and tone
summary.what_it_does: Plus adds an AI assistant directly inside Microsoft PowerPoint and Google Slides, so users create and edit slides without switching apps. Users can describe a presentation in a few sentences or pick a preset, then generate single slides or whole decks. Its Insert, Rewrite, and Remix tools add layouts, change text length or tone, and reformat content into chosen designs. It can also import PDFs, Word docs, and text files and convert them into PowerPoint or Google Slides presentations. Team features include importing custom templates, adding logos, fonts, and colors, and sharing presets and custom instructions. The page says it creates native PPTX files and Google Slides presentations.
notable: Native add-on for PowerPoint and Google Slides, with no separate app to learn
Remix tool reformats existing slides or raw text into a chosen design
Imports PDFs, Word docs and text files and converts them into slide decks
Team features: custom templates, brand fonts and colors, shared presets
caveats: Free 7-day trial; multiple paid plans follow, with prices not stated on the page
Team and enterprise features such as white-glove template conversion and custom libraries are offered with the teams plan or enterprise customers
The page itself notes AI has many limitations and output needs review
